subject: Supplier registration: Redwood vendor packet & kickoff next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier registration: Redwood vendor packet & kickoff next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for taking this through with the Acme Health procurement team. Attached is our standard new-supplier packet to get the vendor setup and PO process started. Quick checklist to help move this along: 

- Complete and return the W-9 (attached: Redwood_W9.pdf)
- Review and sign our Master Services Agreement (MSA summary attached) or flag any redlines
- Provide bank details for ACH (we can provide secure ACH instructions once you confirm the billing contact)
- SOC 2 / security questionnaire (see Redwood_Security_FAQ.pdf) — Vivek is on this thread for any technical/security follow-up
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) — if you require a template, we can produce that
- PO contact & billing email for Acme to push the first PO to

Attachments included in this email: Redwood_Supplier_Welcome_Packet_AcmeHealth.pdf, Redwood_Security_FAQ.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf. I’ve also generated a DocuSign envelope to capture the supplier profile and MSA signature if that helps (link below).

Proposed next steps:
1) Samantha confirms the PO contact and whether Acme requires a vendor portal registration
2) We transmit any additional tax or compliance templates requested
3) Quick 30-min kickoff call to align on invoicing cadence, PO references, and escalation path — happy to schedule for tomorrow or later this week

If you prefer, we can route the initial PO to billing@redwood.com.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Supplier_Welcome_Packet_AcmeHealth.pdf (pdf), Redwood_Security_FAQ.pdf (pdf), Redwood_W9.pdf (pdf)
From: Samantha Lee <procurement@acmehealth.com>

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier registration: Redwood vendor packet & kickoff next steps

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for sending over the packet — received. A couple quick clarifying questions before we proceed: 

- We require the supplier profile filled via DocuSign for our records. Can you confirm the contact who will sign (company name + title)?
- For tax purposes, is Redwood providing the standard W-9 only or do you also have a foreign tax form alternative (W-8) if applicable?
- Please provide a sample invoice (one-page) that includes preferred PO reference fields so our AP team can map it into our ERPs.

Also, can you confirm the legal payee name and remit-to address you expect on the PO? Our onboarding team usually needs the full remit details to create the vendor record.

We can do a 30-min kickoff tomorrow afternoon (Tue) if that works — our team is free between 2:00–4:30 PM PT.

Best regards,
Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
